items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Monk Smith and Benji White and Pinky and Rene Jalpe and Earl. And maybe a piano player? And well Sieg Christensen was with them when I was with them.

ctx.x: Oh I was going to ask you about the Earl Crumb, did you ever play in his band and if so what?

Yeah I played drums in the Owls Orchestra. Earl used to like to go sailing, he had a couple of girlfriends I think, I don't make it too public but he used to get lost on the weekend at the Yacht Club and they'd ring me up and say come on out and play and then I'd sit in with him and play for Take Earl's Place on the same weekends. I don't know, right now I can't remember the bass player, you know him. The tuba, yeah. Dan LeBlanc. Dan LeBlanc. Dan LeBlanc. Dan LeBlanc. He was at the Sangle with us. Dan played…
The original Owls were also string band players weren't they?

items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Pinky and Pete and Al Herrick.

ctx.x: Did you play over on the Gulf Coast much in the early years? Oh yeah. You did? Spot jobs. Spot jobs. Who did you play over there mostly with? Pinky and Pete and Al Herrick. In the early years in the 30s. No. It's when we were kids when we got, we got a job over there at the hotels. So in the 20s.
In the 20s. In the 30s. We got a job over at the hotels. And Pete and Al Herg.
